remarks: Location, location, location! Welcome to resort-style desert living in the highly sought-after Sunrise Villas community, nestled in the prime south side of Palm Springs. Tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac, this single-level 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom residence offers 1,391 square feet of comfortable, private living space. This home features high ceilings and an open-concept layout designed to maximize natural light. The functional floor plan includes a bright kitchen, spacious primary suite with abundant closet space, and dedicated indoor laundry.
